About.description:
What a choice is about (`Decision::about`): each field given where
the purpose (or the terms) has it (docs/protocol.md §5).

cap.description: A capacity it depends on (the young vampires Neonate Breach spares).

card.description: A card it names: in play (`copy`) or by name (`id`).

detail.description:
What sets it apart within its purpose, a snake_case id
(`minion_of`: `lock`, `lock_vampires`, `corrupt`…).

m.description:
A second amount (the most a Methuselah burns, the damage blood
avoids).

minion.description:
The minion it concerns: the one blood moves from, a block
attempt's, the one entering play.

n.description: How many: still to pay, at most, to discard, damage, blood…

seat.description:
The Methuselah it concerns: whose minions, ash heap, hand,
uncontrolled region.

to.description: A second minion: the one blood moves to.

oneOf.description: An action card's action (not one of the kinds above).
An action granted by a card in play or a vampire's ability.
Enter combat with a Red List minion.
A value this reader does not know.
Its Methuselah was ousted.
Ended otherwise (its acting minion gone).
A value this reader does not know.

ActionRef.description: What an action is: its kind, its card, what grants it.

card.description: The action card, for a card action.

source.description: What grants the action: a card in play, or another vampire.

oneOf.description: Blocks may be attempted.
A block is being attempted.
Blocks declined by all.
A diablerie after the action (the diablerist's choices).
A value this reader does not know.

bleed_target.description: The Methuselah bled, for a bleed.

blocker.description: The minion attempting the block, or that blocked, and its intercept.

card.description: The action card, for a card action.

declined.description: The Methuselahs who declined to block.

source.description: The card in play granting the action (a location's, an equipment's).

Allocated.description: Points allocated to a Methuselah or a card in play.

Allocation.description:
An allocation of points under way, answered whole with
`Command::Allocate`: all `points` given, at most `cap` to a recipient,
at least `min_nonzero` recipients given some.

oneOf.description: No allocation under way.
Not one amount per recipient.
The amounts do not add up to the points.
A recipient over its cap.
Fewer recipients given points than required.

seed.description:
Its sampling seed: replaying uses the recorded options, the seed
re-simulates the bot.

weights.description: The weights' SHA-256, for a network.

oneOf.description: A standing order (`vote_all`) or an allocation answered whole.
A lone pass, the seat's settings hiding the rest.

Card.description:
A physical card: its copy where the viewer may follow it, its KRCG id
where the viewer sees its face. A card in another seat's hand, a
library or a crypt has neither (a card back).

crypt.description: A crypt card (else a library card), hidden or not.

nth.description:
Its label among the copies of the same card from the same deck the
viewer sees (1, 2…: "Embrace #2"): the lowest number no other
visible copy holds, given as it comes into sight. With `id` only.

CardRef.description:
A card an option names: its KRCG id when the viewer may know it, its
copy when it is one physical card (on the table; not a card in hand,
where copies alike are one option).

from.description: Played from cards stored on this card in play, not from the hand.

ChoiceKey.description:
What identifies an option: two options of one decision never share a
key (copies alike in hand are one option). A record keeps each answer
by its key, with the engine's copy numbers: a later engine finds the
same option whatever its index or however it describes it.

ability.description: Which of a card's abilities, when it has several.

actor.description: The minion playing the card, using the ability, taking the action.

amount.description: An amount: blood, pool, votes, X, points.

blood.description: The blood an ability moves onto (+) or off (−) the vampire it is on.

card.description: The card played, used, taken, discarded or named.

minion.description:
The minion the option is about otherwise (blocker, voter, payer,
the vampire an ability is on).

mode.description: The mode a card is played in (`play`).

value.description: A clan, a Discipline, a circle chosen: its snake_case id.

zone.description: Where a card chosen by name comes from (a search).

strike.description:
Its strike once declared (the blocker chooses knowing the acting
minion's), kept shown once resolved until the next pair.

sides.description: Each side, the acting minion's first.

about.description:
The particulars of the choice a prompt names, beyond its purpose,
source and options: how many, whose, which minion or card.

options.description:
The options shown (the seat's settings may hide some: indices keep
the engine's numbering).

prompt.description:
What is chosen, in English ("Camarilla's Iron Fist: choose the
Methuselah who gains 1 pool"), when the seat's settings ask for text.

purpose.description: What an effect asks the choice for, when one does.

source.description:
The card (or minion, by its card) whose terms or effect this
decision chooses, when it is one: the options' `effects` say what
each choice gets.

undo.description: `Command::Undo` would take back the seat's previous decision.

Effect.description:
One thing an option does, to whom (docs/protocol.md §7): a curated
vocabulary — a kind, an amount, whom it applies to — not the engine's
own effects.

card.description: A card named (to hand, discarded, fetched).

clan.description: Of this clan (a snake_case clan id: the chosen Toreador).

copy.description: The minion or card in play it applies to, when known.

cost.description: A cost paid to take the option, not what it does.

detail.description:
What sets it apart within its kind, a snake_case id: `this_round`,
`guns`, `per_counter`, `then_bottom`… (docs/protocol.md §7).

n.description: Signed: gained (+) or lost, spent (−); with `x`, per X.

on.description:
Whom it applies to, as the option sees it: its target, the card's
minion, the acting minion…; the seat's own when absent.

role.description: What a chosen minion or Methuselah becomes (`role`).

seat.description: The Methuselah it applies to (a pool, a hand), when known.

when.description: Only if this comes to pass.

x.description: The amount is the X chosen (times `n` when given).

oneOf.description: An ally's life.
Immune to damage (`detail`: from a strike, from effects).
A card moved to a zone (`to`), or a minion (`detail`).
The action or the referendum fails (`detail`).
An action declared (`action`), or one granted (`detail`).
The action is a hunt.
A cost reduced.
The card or minion stays (a cost paid to keep it).
What a chosen minion or Methuselah becomes for the card (`role`).
A value this reader does not know.
One Methuselah left (or none).

The last human seat was ousted: the bots do not play on (victory
points as they stand).
A seat left (`Command::Leave`) or went idle too long.

The engine failed (or ran out of steps); the game is recorded with
the failure.

A decision answered (by a human, a bot, a standing order or a lone
pass).

at.description:
Milliseconds since the start, when the host received the
answer (a human's think time includes the client's pacing).

forced.description: Every option offered was this choice.

shown.description: The options the seat was shown, when its settings hid some.

oneOf.description:
The seat took back its decisions from `to` on: the game continues
from `to`, decision numbers repeat from there, and a reader drops
the decision entries it takes back.
A command refused.
Not the pending decision (answered already, or a stale client).
The pending decision is another seat's, or none is pending.
No option with that index.
Nothing to take back.
No allocation under way, or amounts it does not allow.
No vote to cast that way.
`join` first, with a valid token.
Not valid JSON, or not a command.
Too many commands: slow down.

text.description: The event told in English, when the seat's settings ask for text.

oneOf.description: A decision taken, by any seat, as the recipient may know it.
A decision passed by itself (the seat's settings left only a pass).

The seat took back its decisions from `to` on: the client drops
what it showed since (the next view is the table at `to`).
A minion or a card comes into play (on a minion, or not).

effect.description:
A lasting effect whose card is in the ash heap (a marker on
its minion), not a card of its own: no copy.

minion.description: A minion, of this kind (not a card on the table).

oneOf.description: A card in play moves to another minion (or off one).

effect.description:
A lasting effect whose card is in the ash heap (a marker on
its minion), not a card of its own: no copy.

oneOf.description:
A minion or a card leaves play: to `to` when it went to a seat's
zone (a burned minion to its ash heap), contested (a vampire set
aside while its Methuselahs contest it).

effect.description:
A lasting effect whose card is in the ash heap (a marker on
its minion), not a card of its own: no copy.

enters.description: Goes to torpor (true) or leaves it.

oneOf.description: The Edge goes to `seat` (absent: burned, no one holds it).

action.description: The political action it was called by.

hunted.description: A blood hunt's: the diablerist hunted.

oneOf.description:
A combatant's strike declared (the acting minion's first: the
blocker chooses knowing it); `None`: no strike.

A pair of strikes resolved: each side's strike and the damage it
dealt before prevention.

bots.description: Per bot seat, the profile resolved.

spec.description:
The spec as played: the seed always set, human seats' names
replaced by "human".

failure.description: The engine's failure, when it failed: message, location, backtrace.

seed.description:
The deal's seed; the host picks one when absent (and records it).
32 bits: exact as a JSON number in every language.

time_limit.description: In player turns; the engine's default when absent.

In.title: In
In.description:
A command as sent: an optional client id, echoed by an `error` it
causes.

oneOf.description:
Take the seat (the first frame on a connection: the seat's token,
on a server), or take it again after a disconnection: `after` the
last message's `seq` received, the host resends what followed;
otherwise `joined`, then the pending decision if it is the seat's.
Take an option of the pending decision, by its `index`.

Answer an allocation under way whole: one amount per recipient, in
the decision's `allocation.recipients` order.

Cast all the votes the decision's `votes` counts one way; a
standing order for the rest of the polling (each vampire's turn
to cast is answered by it).

Take back the seat's last decision, from the pending `decision`
(whose `undo` says it can: nothing decided since, nothing hidden
revealed). Named so a command sent twice undoes once.

Change some of the seat's settings; the pending decision is sent
again under them.
Leave the game: it ends, recorded as abandoned by the seat.

stored.description: Cards stored on it (face down ones hidden to others), top last.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without a command before the game ends as abandoned.

Marker.description:
Public state on a minion beyond blood and cards: counters, marks,
effects lasting a while.

seat.description: The Methuselah it belongs to (corruption counters).

text.description: English, when the seat's settings ask for text.

MarkerKind.description:
Public state on a minion beyond blood and cards (completed with
the host, A3).

oneOf.description: Corruption counters (`seat`: whose, `n`).

A card's lasting effect on it (`card` says which, `n` its
counters).
A value this reader does not know.
A library card as a vampire.
A value this reader does not know.

MinionView.description: A minion: named by its card's copy everywhere (options, events).

owner.description: The Methuselah whose ash heap it goes to, when not its controller.

Mode.description:
A card's mode: the printed line it is played from, at which
Disciplines and levels, as which card type.

apart.description:
What sets it apart from the other modes its printed line splits
into (the card's own, offered or not): its effects not all of them
have. Empty for a line not split.

card_type.description:
The card type it is played as, for a card of several types:
`action`, `action_modifier`, `reaction`, `combat`, `reflex`…

disciplines.description: Empty for a card without Discipline requirement.

line.description:
The printed line (one line may split into several modes, told
apart by the option's `effects`).

On.description: Whom an effect applies to, from the option.

oneOf.description: The option's target.
The minion the card or ability is on.
The minion playing the card or using the ability.
The acting minion of the action under way.
The minion the card chose.
The card itself.
The target uncontrolled vampire.
The seat's prey.
A value this reader does not know.

OptionKind.description: What an option does (the engine's choice kinds).

oneOf.description: A value this reader does not know.

OptionView.description:
An option offered: its index (what an answer names), what it is, and
what it does.

abilities.description: An ability's: how many its source has (`key.ability` says which).

ability.description: Which of a card's abilities, when it has several.

actor.description: The minion playing the card, using the ability, taking the action.

amount.description: An amount: blood, pool, votes, X, points.

blood.description: The blood an ability moves onto (+) or off (−) the vampire it is on.

card.description: The card played, used, taken, discarded or named.

effects.description:
What taking it does when its key does not say: a cost, what a
chosen Methuselah or minion gets, an ability's effects, what a
pass lets happen.

index.description:
The engine's index: stable while the decision is pending, even when
the seat's settings hide other options.

minion.description:
The minion the option is about otherwise (blocker, voter, payer,
the vampire an ability is on).

mode.description: The mode a card is played in (`play`).

text.description: The option in English, when the seat's settings ask for text.

value.description: A clan, a Discipline, a circle chosen: its snake_case id.

zone.description: Where a card chosen by name comes from (a search).

Out.title: Out
Out.description:
A message as sent: numbered per seat from 1, so a client rejoining
`after` the last it received gets the rest.

reply_to.description: The client id of the command it answers (an `error`).

oneOf.description:
What one step of the game did, in order: a decision taken (its
first event: `decided`, `auto_passed` or `undone`) and what
followed until the next decision; or, once, the deal. With the
table after it when the seat's settings ask views on every step.

The seat must decide; sent again on `join` and after a settings
change while pending.
A command refused; the game is unchanged.

vp_halves.description: Per seat, in halves of a victory point.

winner.description:
The game's winner: the most victory points, at least 2 of them,
alone.

oneOf.description: The game is over.
A value this reader does not know.

A bot, by profile name: one the host offers (`/version` lists
them): a network policy at a temperature, or a scripted style.

Purpose.description:
What a choice an effect asks is for (the engine's interrupt): with
`source`, what the decision chooses. Open: a later engine adds more.

oneOf.description:
Blood Trade: 1 blood from `from` to a vampire of another
Methuselah's, the player's choice.

Heidelberg Castle: `seat` moves from `from` to another ready
vampire of theirs — chosen first (`to`), then the blood (any
amount, the excess to the bank: ANK 20170804), then equipment and
retainers one at a time, each one `to` could hold (LSJ 19980831),
until done.

"Burned unless its controller burns n pool" (Conquest of Humanity):
`seat` pays or lets `card` burn.

Nightmares upon Nightmares: `minion` is locked unless its
Methuselah discards a card (not replaced until their master phase).

Society of Leopold: `minion` burns `n` blood or is burned, its
Methuselah's choice (Pass: burned) — or `card` is burned instead
(Robert Carter: "Carter's employer burns 1 blood, or Carter is
burned").

A replacement Visit from the Capuchin would take instead while a
draw alternative applies too: one treatment or the other (ANK
20200905; rules-qa 9.4). `except`: the card being replaced.

Draw up to hand size, each card from the library or a draw
alternative.

Heart of Nizchetus: `left` cards still to draw, `drawn` so far; the
same number then goes to the bottom of the library.
`left` cards still to move from hand to the bottom of the library.

Black Market Cache's search: up to `left` more cards to put on
`card`.

"After this ally enters play, burn an ally or retainer you control"
(War Ghoul): the controller's pick among the others, the entering
ally itself if there is none (RTR 19961113).

"After this ally enters play, burn it unless you remove an ally or
vampire in your ash heap from the game" (Rotting Behemoth): the
controller may decline, and the ally burns (LSJ 20030701-2).

A block attempt made costly as it goes on (Where the Veil Thins
[OBL], Tenebrous Form [OBT]): its minion pays the `n` blood that
card adds, or resigns the attempt and pays nothing (LSJ
20031121-2); an ally cannot burn blood.

Dawn Operation [for]: the vampire attempting to block may cancel
its attempt (`ChooseMinion` it, or pass).

Amici Noctis: `left` blood to distribute; first how much to the
pool (at most `cap`), the rest among the ready `clan` vampires.

Amici Noctis: `left` blood for the ready `clan` vampires below
capacity, 1 each, offered in arena order from minion `next`: give
or skip, a skip only while enough of them are left.

A minion controlled by `of`, chosen as an effect resolves (Break
the Bonds [obf], The Platinum Protocol [pro]: "the target is chosen
upon resolution", ANK 20240706): locked, if the player wants to, or
given one of the player's corruption counters.

Whose corruption counter on `minion` burns, several Methuselahs'
being on it (Aniel).

`minion` burns `blood` to be immune to `damage` unpreventable
aggravated damage, or takes it (Rutor's Hand [THA]).

`seat` looks at `of`'s hand and discards a card of their choice
from it, which `of` replaces (Revelations [aus]).

`seat` discards `left` more cards of their choice from hand (Shroud
of Decay [obl]); all `done` are replaced once every discard is made
(advanced rules §6.8.3). `seat` reorders the top `total` cards of
their library (Eulogio Sánchez de los Reyes): `placed` of them
chosen so far, from the top down; the rest still in their old order
below them.

`seat` removes `left` more cards of their choice from `of`'s ash
heap from the game; then `of` burns `pool` pool (Shroud of Decay
[OBL]; LSJ 20090710: there is no order to the ash heap) — from
their own, pool 0, Marchesa Liliana's cost. Burned vampires are ash
heap cards too (rules-qa 42.7).

"You can search your library (shuffle afterward), hand and/or ash
heap for a Discipline master card and put it on this new vampire"
(Childe of the Revolution): put on, not played.

Learjet: `seat` may draw an additional card (`DrawLibrary`), the
hand then discarded down; or pass.

Infernal Pursuit [CEL], several cards replaced at once: one
replacement of `seat`'s and its `extra` additional cards, then as
many discarded, before the next (ANK 20180925-1).
Those `left` extra cards of `seat`'s discarded, not replaced.

Baltimore Purge: `seat` chooses a ready vampire of `of`'s not older
than `host` (the purge's vampire), sent to torpor with it once
every Methuselah's is chosen.

"Steal up to n blood" (François Villon G2): `seat` sets how much, 1
to `max`, from `from` to `to` (`SetX`).

"Move up to n blood from the acting vampire to this new vampire"
(Third Tradition: Progeny): `seat` sets how much, 0 to `max` of
what `minion` has, to `to` (`SetX`).

Antonio d'Erlette (`minion`): a mage ally from `seat`'s library or
hand he could play, put in play, its cost paid (Pass: none); the
library shuffled either way.

"Remove a crypt card in your uncontrolled region from the game"
(Wider View): the player's pick, the counters on it to the blood
bank; removed cards are public (LSJ 20080314).

"As … its controller changes, its controller chooses a ready
vampire they control" (The Rack): none if they have none.

Garibaldi-Meucci Museum: the ash heap card requiring an Anarch,
then the hand card it is exchanged for.

"If the attached minion is about to leave the ready region, you can
burn this card to gain n pool" (Priority Contract).
"You can lock this card … to gain n pool" (The Black Throne).

"You can burn those counters to steal that minion" (Cave of
Apples).

"You can burn 1 blood from this card to make that vampire Anarch"
(Twilight Camp).

Ashur Tablets' picks from `seat`'s ash heap: first the card to hand
(a pass chooses none), then up to `left` more shuffled into the
library (a pass stops), `to_library` once the hand card is chosen.

"A non-titled vampire you control becomes Anarch" (Gilbert Duane):
the player's pick, none if they have none.

Anarch Convert entering play: "you can remove him from the game to
make a non-titled vampire you control Anarch" — that vampire chosen
(`chosen`), then "either gain 1 pool or draw 1 card from your
crypt". Before any contest (LSJ 20080526, RTR 20180303): `forced`
when he came out beside a copy his Methuselah controls (no
voluntary self-contest); declined, his contests are staged.

"Add n blood to a `clan` vampire in your uncontrolled region"
(Hunting the Beast [AUS]): the player's pick, none if they have
none. With no clan, any of them, and optional ("may move a counter
from the bank to a vampire in his or her uncontrolled region",
Flames of Insurrection).

"Lock this card or burn n pool" (Bleeding the Vine): `ResolveRider`
locks it (if unlocked), `BurnPool` pays.

"Burns n pool unless they burn a vampire they control with
capacity `cap` or more to burn this card" (Antediluvian
Awakening): `BurnPool` pays, `ChooseMinion` burns that vampire and
the card.

"Search your crypt for a `clan` vampire … move them to your
uncontrolled region (shuffle afterward)" (Disciple of Lazarus): a
crypt card (`Choice::AshVampire`, a CRYPT index), or none (Pass).

Solomon Batanea: the slot of `of`'s uncontrolled region that gives
1 blood to `of`'s pool (`Choice::Slot`, `of`'s region).

Erlik entering play: up to `left` more blood moved from `from` to
`seat`'s uncontrolled `clan` vampires, one at a time
(`Choice::Slot`); Pass stops. His contests are staged after (LSJ
20080526).

"Move any amount of blood from the Blood Brothers in the <circle>
to any other Blood Brothers in this circle" (Jerry,
Redistribution): one move at a time among `seat`'s — `from` the
source, `to` the destination, then the amount (`Choice::SetX`),
each move a gain of its own (Slake the Thirst; owner, rules-qa
68.10), one blood move a pair of them (`paired`, source and
destination); Pass ending the moves. With `equipment`, their
equipment too ("move any amount of blood and equipment",
Redistribution), one at a time, as many as wanted (`moving` the one
picked).

"Move any number of blood counters from your pool to 1 or more
vampires you control" (Gird Minions): a vampire (`to`), then the
amount (`Choice::SetX`), up to its room (rulebook: no more blood
than capacity); Pass ends the moves.

Legacy: `minion`'s base version searched for in `seat`'s crypt
(`Choice::AshVampire`, taken from the crypt first, then the ash
heap), uncontrolled region (`Choice::Slot`) and ash heap, and
merged with it; Pass finds none. The crypt shuffled after.

New Blood entering play: the circle he belongs to
(`Choice::ChooseCircle`, among `state::circles`), or his own circle
of one (Pass).

"Move a wraith or zombie ally from your ash heap to your ready
region" (Split the Veil): the player's pick among the allies
matching one of `of`; with `named`, the pick is named for the
action being declared, put in play as it resolves (Hel-Blá).

Victor Donaldson: `card`, canceled as `seat` played it, may move
from their ash heap to their library, shuffled (`ResolvePrinted`).

Malgorzata: the vampire of `seat`'s uncontrolled region to remove,
another than the action's target (`Choice::Slot`).

Lázár Dobrescu: named as the action is announced (rules-qa default
readings) — `from`, a vampire with blood in `of`'s uncontrolled
region, then the one of `seat`'s that gets it (`Choice::Slot`).

The Great Beast's three Disciplines, one at a time (`Choice::Slot`
into `GREAT_BEAST_DISCIPLINES`).

The Erciyes Fragments: the library card of `seat`'s prey's ash heap
to move onto `card`, face down (`Choice::FindCard`).

The Sargon Fragment: the library card of `seat`'s ash heap the
action declared names.

Giovanni del Georgio: the card two copies of which in `of`'s ash
heap the action declared names (`Terms::PreyAshPair`).

"You can put this card on this vampire" (Fever Pitch [FOR]/[PRE]):
`ChooseMinion` it, or pass — optional, though never worse than the
ash heap: an agent may take it unasked (owner, 2026-10-08: rules-qa
53.5).

"You can add 1 counter to this location" (Cursed Abattoir):
`ResolveRider` it, or pass — never worse to add (rules-qa 55.6).

The Path of Lilith: `seat` may lock `card` to put a torture counter
on `minion` (`ResolveRider`), or pass.

"You can gain n pool" printed on `minion` (Matasuntha): Pass, or
`ResolvePrinted` to gain it — optional, never worse.

"This acting vampire can burn n blood to move the stolen vampire to
your ready region" (Graverobbing [DOM]): `ChooseMinion` it, or
pass.

"Once each turn, when you draw a card from your library, you may
place that card on the bottom of your library and draw a new card"
(Blackhorse Tanner, `minion`): `DrawLibrary` to do it with `card`,
just drawn, or pass.
A value this reader does not know.
A value this reader does not know.

Role.description:
What a chosen minion or Methuselah becomes for the card choosing it

oneOf.description: Does not unlock as normal (Toreador Grand Ball's first).
Its non-bleed actions cannot be blocked (the Grand Ball's second).
The card's chosen minion, for its later effects.
Becomes Anarch (Gilbert Duane, Anarch Convert).
No reactions, blocks or votes this turn (Expel).
A value this reader does not know.

bot.description: The bot profile; absent for a human.

name.description:
Shown to the table; a human seat's is not recorded (records say
"human").

in_play.description: Cards in play the seat controls on no minion.

limbo.description: Cards the seat is playing, not resolved yet.

vp_halves.description:
Victory points, in halves of a point (a survivor at the time limit
scores 1 half).

Settings.description:
A human seat's preferences (fields left out take their default);
changed during the game by `Command::Settings`.

opportunities.description:
Asked about every opportunity (true), or only in its moment
(false): a wake outside an action that concerns the seat, a block
denial short of the action's stealth, an any-time ability where
nothing else is on offer are passed over; a decision left with a
pass alone passes by itself.

text.description:
English renderings beside the data (`text` on options, events,
markers, strikes; a decision's `prompt`): for a client that does
not compose its own.

views.description:
Table views sent on every step (bots' included: a client
animating each move) or only with the seat's decisions and the
game's end.

SettingsPatch.description: Some settings to change; the others stay.

banished.description: A banished vampire, waiting to be influenced out again.

cards.description: The cards it carries there, out of play until it returns.

SpecError.title: SpecError
SpecError.description: Why a game spec is refused (`POST /games`).

card.description: The card it comes from (a weapon, a strike card).

resolved.description: Resolved this pair: the damage it dealt.

text.description: English, when the seat's settings ask for text.

oneOf.description: A strike whose effect is its card's text.
The opponent's weapon named with the strike moves to the striker.

transfers.description: The active seat's transfers left, during its influence phase.

viewer.description: The viewing seat; absent: every card shown (records, tests).

Target.description:
What an action or an option is aimed at: a Methuselah, or a card on
the table (a minion, an uncontrolled vampire, a card in play).

Terms.description: A referendum's terms chosen so far.

pending.description:
The Methuselahs points are still to be allocated to, in order: the
first is allocated to now, the last gets the rest.

id.description:
`primogen`, `prince`, `baron`, `justicar`, `inner_circle`,
`archbishop`, `bishop`, `cardinal`, `priscus`, `regent`, `magaji`,
`independent` (named in `of`), `votes` (a title by its votes only).

of.description:
The city (a prince, a baron, an archbishop), the clan (a justicar,
the Inner Circle) or an independent title's name.

votes.description: Its votes, when the title says them (`independent`, `votes`).

copy.description: The minion or card in play casting it.
